description: Calculates thermal duty transferred to/from a liquid stream experiencing sensible temperature change.
applicability_conditions: Single-phase sensible heating/cooling (no phase change latent heat)
applicability: mass flow, specific heat, temp difference available
non_applicability_conditions: Boiling or condensing streams without latent heat term
assumptions: Constant Cp over the specified temperature range
